title: Duration, withdrawal, rejection, and notice
summary: Different events terminate or protect the power to accept in different ways.
notes: Use the context of conversation, market changes, reward purpose, and publicity to analyze lapse or revocation. Compare a mere stated deadline with an enforceable holding-open commitment. An option changes the consequences of some ordinary termination events. Dispatch and receipt rules answer a communication-timing issue after the response has qualified as acceptance.
